WITH global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount) as avg_budget
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
event_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(amount) as event_avg_amount
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.link_to_event,
    ea.event_avg_amount,
    ga.avg_budget
  FROM event_avgs ea
  CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
  WHERE ea.event_avg_amount > ga.avg_budget
),
above_avg_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(event_avg_amount) as mean_above_avg
  FROM above_avg
)
SELECT 
  aa.link_to_event,
  aa.event_avg_amount,
  aa.event_avg_amount - aa.avg_budget as beats_global_average,
  aa.event_avg_amount - aam.mean_above_avg as gap_from_above_avg_mean
FROM above_avg aa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_mean aam
ORDER BY gap_from_above_avg_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
